notes.title: Save 30% during the Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[h1]Steam summer sale has started![/h1]

We are very excited to participate in the steam summer sale and offer our game with a discount of 30%.

We are constantly updating the game ever since the game was initially launched into the early access and we are planning to add more and more content.

All over is an indie early access action RPG/adventure/puzzle with story-based quests, puzzles, and action-based battles. In the game, you will take the role of our hero who will need to use his wits to solve different puzzles, use his sword, and spells to fight and find loot. Gather resources to build your home and craft potions and items. Fight legendary bosses and venture into the depth of the dungeons.

Join our hero and save Abelon!

* Offer ends July 9 at 10am PDT

notes.title: Quality of life
notes.content:
Heroes!

After receiving multiple feedbacks with bugs and enhancements requests - we are updating our game with the adjustments and an expanded training area to better explain the game mechanics

The following has been updated
[h2]Training area[/h2]
The new training area will now cover the following:
[list]
[*] [h3]Boosters / Fire traps[/h3] - You can now learn about the difference between boosters and traps
[*] [h3]Torches[/h3] - You will now learn how to pick loot from the ground as well as pick up torches from the walls
[*] [h3]Running[/h3] - You will experience the joy of running ;)
[*] [h3]Fighting[/h3] - You will learn how to use your sword (or magic, if you have learned it)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/b0693a35f2c23d68fecf81c7a0b357141f45f072.png[/img]
The training area is always accessible in memory lane via the Merchant.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
As always, more bugs have been ironed out, please keep on reporting if you find new ones. We really appreciate it.

[h2]Dubbing[/h2]
Some of the players (namely YQ Maoski) have advised us to offer an option to disable the dubbing and so it is now available in the options menu.

[h2]Sleep[/h2]
We are still improving our mechanics here, however, the quality of sleep in different locations is better than others (depending on how comfortable your hero is). We will add more on this topic later on.

[h2]Trees transparency[/h2]
The silhouette of our hero is now seen when walking behind most trees (we will be adding support for all trees in future updates)

[h2]Respawn location[/h2]
Our hero will now respawn back home if he owns one.



As always we’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts, suggestions, and feedback (good or bad) here at Abelon. Please write to us on our new discord channel (https://discord.gg/s3K8ssn), steam community or simply write us an email to wizards@overall.games

notes.title: Shops! New item sets and currency!
notes.content:
[h1]Heroes! We have some updates for you.[/h1]

We have listened to your requests and have implemented a whole new store interface, new legendary weapons/armor sets and a merchant to sell them with a new currency.

As with previous versions we’re also pushing towards a full graphic update of the game and have updated multiple maps/items/UI with new shiny HD graphics. 

[h2]New store interface[/h2]
Many of you complained about the way the old store worked and so we upgraded it to a more straightforward one. You can now see the item, its price and just walk to it and get all the information / buy it. The old system is still used for selling your old equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/eb2b037c6030a8ca9e178b43ab3d073005511d3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/6ea8375610f06051dc071297c3b5e84ef96b0972.png[/img]


[h2]New item sets[/h2]
There are 4 new sets, each consists of 5 items : a weapon, a helm, an armor, a shield and a ring

The “nature” set will give you regeneration abilities
The “earth” set will reduce the damage you take from poison and improve your defenses
The “ice” set will improve your freezing skills
and the “vampiric” set will help you drain the life power of other creatures

We are still tweaking and adding abilities to the sets and will probably need to balance them, however, the sets are here and are finally available for sale at the merchant store

[h2]The merchant[/h2]
While there are many stores that sell more common items, the merchant at memory lane and in the dungeon rooms offer you a quick way to buy items from the sets mentioned above.
Unlike regular stores, the merchant want memory crystals for its wares and so you will need to venture into the depth of the memory dungeon and find memory crystals to be used as the new currency

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/984ce0e0efe2e3cf68ea6eb9377eea618d00dac5.png[/img]

[h2]Graphic updates[/h2]
While we’re constantly updating the maps, we are also adjusting the item appearance and in this version, we’ve also added a new way to find loot - on the floor. You can now simply walk to a potion or a sack of coins and just pick them up. There is loot all around, especially in the dungeons and mines. These are easy to grab and will help you complete the quests more easily.

[u]The following maps have been updated:[/u]
Digsome / Digsome mines
A few puzzles have been reworked
Rebelsome
Player house (HOME)
All stores/merchants
Dungeons 

We’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts, suggestions and feedback (good or bad) here at abelon. Please write to us on our new discord channel (https://discord.gg/s3K8ssn), steam community or simply write us an email to wizards@overall.games

notes.title: Achievements, night and day, torches and many more graphic updates
notes.content:
[h3][b]Achievements are here![/b][/h3]
We already have 20 new achievements with many more to come. Win the arena tournament, kill a boss or finish an important quest - can you get all the achievements?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/103f07698e73e04ccfaf43f88053a69cac508019.png[/img]

[h3][b]Let there be light![/b][/h3]
The dimension of time has entered All over. Stores will only be opened during working hours and the environment lighting will change according to the time of day. While we just scratched the surface of what we’re planning to do here, time of day will bring new options into play.

[h3][b]Torches[/b][/h3]
Torches are now available and will provide you with the means of seeing in the dark. Buy one, craft one or simply walk to an existing torch and grab it. Torches will become more and more important as you venture into dungeons and other dark places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/83ed54cf274be84a73eb2584749742419f593080.png[/img]

[h3][b]Graphics[/b][/h3]
We are constantly updating our graphical assets. This update includes many updates to the items and maps.
The following maps were updated with an all new look:
The Animal resort
The blue cave & the blue cave riddle
Amber town
The blacksmith
The carpenter
The coffee shop
The Inn
The forgotten forest
The evil king fortress
Many more updates are coming in the next versions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/81c70805dbb5de788d41a3416c1a0d67bcc5f209.png[/img]

[h3][b]Respawn menu option [/b][/h3]
As we are still in early access and some issues may arise - we added a menu option to help you resolve minor bugs by clicking the respawning option and resuming the game with all your progress, XP, gold and HP/MANA stats at the forgotten forest.
Use this as a last resort, as this will add to your death counter.

We’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts, suggestions and feedback (good or bad) here at Abelon. Please write to us on our new discord channel (https://discord.gg/s3K8ssn), steam community or simply write us an email to wizards@overall.games

notes.title: New Graphics! New action based battle system! New loot, weapons&armor to equip!
notes.content:
We are very excited to introduce our new look. We now properly support 16:9 with a brand new HUD and lots of graphic upgrades (many more to come). Our battle system has been sharpened and now feels more natural. You can now enter our new battle arena which will find suitable enemies with improved AI to test your battle strategy and capabilities. You can now select which weapon and armor to use and adjust your strategy based on the mobs / bosses you meet.

Version 0.8.04 Release notes:

[h3][b]Battle system[/b][/h3]
We have finally removed all the old turn based battles. The new battle system has been improved and now feels more smooth. A new hp/mana bars system has been implemented to help you identify your and the mobs current status. We removed the button-mashing requirement and you are now able to hold the attack key for non-stop attack allowing you to concentrate on your health, potions and spells. A new equip menu now enables you to choose the right equipment for your battles and a quick optimize button can help you pick the best set to use.
A new AI will make mobs smarter and make your fights tougher yet balanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/1a5ef8a0005b6c1abc7252a9c5ec7a19e64f18fc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/a6c2be260a54eef5403ef24e6b940cfede61d888.png[/img]

[h3][b]New battle arena[/b][/h3]
The battle area is still in the works and will contain many more features. While you’re waiting for the new features you can still enjoy three difficulty tiers each with multiple types of mobs that adjust to your level and skill, win prizes by surviving 12 waves of angry mobs which may sometimes include mini bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/c903ec89d755b64168ffc2aee7dc35eb12175513.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Graphics major overhaul[/b][/h3]
A new shiny HUD and lots of new icons were added. Our resolution was upgraded to 16:9 and the game will now automatically open in full screen to allow better immersion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/0e7d3bdebb1af7e9e9c92d97f8110c9447a19efe.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37170941/bf79d8f5bca1272f67164f1a8802a7ecf317d5d3.png[/img]

[h3][b]New training area[/b][/h3]
A new, basic training area to help you learn how to equip, attack and cast spells at enemies. The training area is available at memory lane from the merchant NPC.

We’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts, suggestions and feedback (good or bad) here at Abelon. Please write to us on our new discord channel (https://discord.gg/s3K8ssn), steam community or simply write us an email to wizards@overall.games

notes.title: New action battle system!
notes.content:
Heroes! Our game is changing! 

We are in the midst of upgrading our game battle system into the new and exciting action based battle system. Our old turn based battle system will be replaced into a more challenging one. You will need to plan ahead, prepare your potions, spells and weapons and make sure you have the right strategy before entering battles and especially the boss rooms.

Version 0.8.03 release notes
[list]
[*] Quality of life improvements
[*] Re-balanced the xp, weapons, bonuses and mobs
[*] Memory lane now contains a new multi level dungeons to venture into
[*] New alternating ever changing challenging dungeon levels with new treasures, mobs and bosses to fight.
[*] Prepare to fight against new multiple types of spiders, skeletons, scorpions, gargoyles, ice mages, demons, orcs and many more! 
[*] Some mobs can now cast spells, poison and freeze you.
[*] New traps and hidden rooms
[*] 5 different treasure chest rarity levels which also adjust based on the depth of the dungeon
[*] Battle system has mostly changed (a few mobs are still using the old turn based system) into new action based battles. 
[*] New memory crystals can now be found at treasure chests within the new dungeon
[*] New dungeon merchant mechanic that will open in the next version that will allow you to purchase new legendary items
[*] Multiple new weapons and armors - more to come in the next few weeks
[*] And of course multiple bug fixes - thank you all for reporting!
[/list]

As always, we are waiting for your feedback, requests and any bug reports.
Send us your notes to wizards@overall.games

notes.title: Crafting, Story, Battle - big changes are coming to Abelon!
notes.content:
[h3]Heroes of Abelon! We are very excited about our update today. Introducing the beginning of our new crafting system and our new battle system.
Our hero can now own a house, collect herbs, craft potions, and items. Dozens of new quests, puzzles, monsters, and new features await you![/h3]

[b]Version 0.8.02 is out and boy do we have news for you:[/b]
[list]
[*] The hero can now own a house!
[*] Introducing a new crafting system which includes (to be upgraded in future versions - suggestions and ideas are welcomed)
[*] Potion table
[*] Anvil
[*] Furnace
[*] Brand new puzzles!
[*] Reworked mission log window with new indications
[*] Dozens of new missions
[*] Improved battle system
[*] 8 new herbs! You can now collect herbs all over Abelon (even in the depth of Digsome mines)
[*] Multiple new enemies/mobs to fight
[*] Zombie immunity mechanic has changed and is now temporary (but worry not, you can still refill it)
[*] Iron mining is now available
[*] A new town was implemented
[*] A new memory area is now accessible - many more updates to that area are planned.
[*] The magical world map has been upgraded to reflect locations of herbs
[*] Boat visual improvements
[*] You can now decorate your home (more in the next updates - send us your suggestion/ideas)
[*] Sleep animations have been further improved (Tent will be upgraded on the next version)
[*] Bulletin board improved
[*] Magic mini-tutorial has been further improved
[*] Digsome mines have been renovated
[*] Prices at stores are now auto-adjusted based on your karma
[*] Added hammer tool and animations for crafting
[*] Added shovel animation and sand digging (as well as sand areas to dig from)
[*] Multiple graphics updates
[*] Inventory screen upgraded for easier use
[*] Puzzle re-balance
[/list]

[i]Yes, we know we may have a few bugs left and we are working hard to iron them out.
However, we would really appreciate your help if you can continue and send any bug/thought/suggestions you may have to wizards@overall.games or write at the community discussion boards.[/i]

notes.title: Update v0.8.01 is now ready!
notes.content:
Heroes!

The world of Abelon is changing, new items, monsters, quality of life and more…
read all about it and embrace yourself for more updates in the coming weeks with more puzzles and missions coming your way.

Version 0.8.01 is out and here are our release notes:
Updated / fixed light settings
Updated / fixed dialogs
Updated mission list directions to be more clear
Updated some monsters / NPCs with AI
Added new events
Added hidden treasure counter viewable via the status page
Fix bug when traveling to Jungle area
Updated job post tasks / interaction
Added explanations to mini-games
Updated color set in some mini-games
Changed reward system
Store names adjusted
Changed hat to Viking Helmet with different stats
Improved access to some areas
Updated some of the sprites
Changed raise dead mechanics
Added tutorial for killing the undead
Updated some dialogs to improve the storytelling
Added animation/effects of Lava/Acid/Poison

Yours truly,
The wizards of Abelon
